provenance.source: Illustrative directional lighting in the published Mathilde mapping frame; source spin pole and phase are unknown
provenance.qualification: Illustrative directional lighting in Mathilde’s explicitly arbitrary J2000-parallel mapping frame. The source has no solved spin pole or rotational phase, so this is not an accurately timed body-fixed Sun solution. The Monochrome view separately retains NEAR encounter illumination and photographed shadows.
